articleTitle: Fuzzy logic control of dual active bridge in solid state transformer applications
publicationTitle: 2016 Tsinghua University-IET Electrical Engineering Academic Forum
abstract: Solid state transformer (SST) enabled microgrid is the trend of microgrid. Most power electronic converters in the SST-enabled DC microgrid behave as constant power loads when their outputs are tightly regulated with little variations around the reference values. The constant power loads have a characteristic of negative incremental impedance, which may degrade the stability of SST-enabled DC microgrid if the dual active bridge (DAB) is not properly controlled. This paper proposes a Fuzzy Logic Controller (FLC) scheme for the DAB converter with constant power load. The proposed FLC is able to stabilize the dc-link voltage in the presence of significant variations in the load power. The proposed FLC is validated by simulation in MATLAB/Simulink for stabilizing the DAB converter with constant power load and resistive load. Simulation studies prove the FLC has satisfactoty performance. Precise regulation of the DC voltage are achieved by FLC, even in cases of load power change.

articleTitle: Stochastic joint optimization using energy storage system and demand response in an electricity market
publicationTitle: 2016 Tsinghua University-IET Electrical Engineering Academic Forum
abstract: In order to achieve clean and sustainable power energy, largescale integration of stochastic generation (SG) and application of ultra-high voltage (UHV) power transmission are becoming two big challenges to Jiangsu's power system. Massive additional operating reserves are needed to cope with uncertainties caused by forecast errors of the stochastic generation and risks of the UHV fault due to its large capacity, which is not economic. To deal with these, a multicomponent operation of SG, pumped-storage plant (PSP), and demand response (DR) is investigated in this paper. Then a rolling optimization method is proposed to obtain the optimal bidding strategy of the SG-PSP-DR union in each bidding section to maximize its overall profit in a modified market environment. Finally, a real case study is presented, where the proposed method is tested with a satisfactory result.

articleTitle: Research and analysis of the improved inverse-droop control strategy for dual mode inverters in micro grid
publicationTitle: 2016 Tsinghua University-IET Electrical Engineering Academic Forum
abstract: In this paper, the control strategy of the dual mode inverter is analyzed firstly. In island operation, inverter uses the improved inverse droop control. Furthermore, in grid-connected operation, the inverter is controlled by the power and current double loop. Then, the inverter smooth switching control method to/from grid-connected and islanded modes is designed in this paper. The switching method proposed by this paper is simple and easy to implement. Finally, the basic inverse droop control and improved inverse droop control method are simulated in the power system simulation software DigSILENT/Power-Factory. The simulation results show that the improved inverse droop control can control the voltage and frequency of the system more effectively, and the modes switching process using the improved inverse droop control is smoother than using the basic inverse droop control. Therefore, the research and analysis of the proposed control strategy verifies its correctness.

articleTitle: A usage-based transmission cost allocation scheme considering impacts of DERS
publicationTitle: 2016 Tsinghua University-IET Electrical Engineering Academic Forum
abstract: With the rapid development of distributed energy resources (DERs), it is of vital importance to develop a well-designed transmission cost allocation scheme to reflect the contributions of DERs to the power system. In this paper, a usage-based transmission cost allocation scheme is proposed considering the capability of DERs. Based on the different intentions of transmission capacity, the transmission costs can be classified into four fractions: operating, contingency, planning and invalid transmission costs. On operating conditions, the transmission costs are identified and allocated according to the actual usage of consumers at each node. On contingency conditions, the transmission cost allocation will be influenced by the behaviors of DERs since DERs can provide emergent power support to help alleviate transmission congestion. On planning conditions, the transmission costs are useful in the future. The residual costs, i.e., the invalid transmission costs, should not allocated by consumers because this fraction is caused by the over investment of transmission owners. The case studies based on the IEEE 30-bus system validates the effectiveness of the proposed scheme and model.

articleTitle: Study on the evaluation model and method of power transmission system reliability
publicationTitle: 2016 Tsinghua University-IET Electrical Engineering Academic Forum
abstract: In order to realize China's power transmission system reliability management reached the international advanced level, it is necessary to change the focus from the power transmission facilities reliability evaluation into the power transmission system reliability evaluation. This paper studies on the power transmission system reliability evaluation model, establishes the identification process of loop outage state and delivery point interruption state, gives the relevant indexes of power transmission system reliability evaluation, and takes the power grid of a city in 2015 as an example to calculate the power transmission system reliability evaluation index.

articleTitle: Memetic algorithm based on self-adaptive differential evolution and improved simplex crossover for large scale global optimization
publicationTitle: 2016 Tsinghua University-IET Electrical Engineering Academic Forum
abstract: Large Scale Global Optimization (LSGO) problems recently arise as an important field of research and many heuristic algorithms have been proposed for solving them. In this paper, a new memetic algorithm for LSGO is proposed, which employs the self-adaptive differential evolution with neighbourhood search (SaNSDE) as the global search operator and an improved version of simplex crossover (ISPX) as the local search operator, respectively. Among them, SaNSDE can gradually self-adapted enhance the ability of searching the whole problem space, while ISPX pays more attention to enhance local search ability and finds better results by applying the knowledge of the previous good solutions. Consequently, suitable offspring replacement strategy is adaptively generated to better balance exploration and exploitation. Experiments on 20 benchmark functions of CEC2010 verify the effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed method. The experimental results also show that the proposed method achieves competitive performance with respect to several other state-of-the-art evolutionary algorithms on LSGO.
